approval_context: Owner requested an animation database with previews in the existing Paint landing page, and reusable animation templates. This approves the catalog capability, not any individual unreviewed animation pose. Follow-up owner request: character-first Mixamo-style motion trial and animated expression previews. This approves the capability and storage interface, not as-yet-unrigged Press Button/Pick Up art.
reusable_insights: Animations need explicit provenance and playback previews: only real committed GIFs should be listed as playable, while unrendered preset specifications must be visibly distinguished as draft templates.
Use reusable timing/phase presets and a metadata manifest to auto-register future 4-direction native v6b animations without modifying front-end HTML.
The preview packager must reject missing or wrongly sized 64x112 native PNG frames rather than fabricate or imply completed action poses.

A Mixamo-style pixel motion chooser must bind an action to the selected character's own native sheet or separately authored, validated action sheet; historical GIF clips are references and must never impersonate a different actor.

Facial animations can reuse a character's registered full-sheet expression deltas on every idle pose frame, combining native breathing with periodic blink instead of substituting static unrelated faces.
compatibility: Does not alter approved character sprite outputs or game action logic.
limitations: Old previews are sourced from examples and remain preview-only. Starter specs do not include new poses or GIFs until a developer authors frames and the owner reviews them. Character-specific Press Button and Pick Up remain unrigged; no source preview substitution. Sit/Type native rows require scene props for meaningful gameplay placement.
